name: Bell Equipment Limited
summary: Bell Equipment Limited designs, manufactures, exports, distributes, and supports a range of heavy equipment for the mining and quarrying, construction, forestry, agriculture, and industry sectors in South Africa, Rest of Africa, and Europe. It operates through two segments, Manufacturing, Assembly, Logistics and Dealer Sales Operations and Direct Sales Operations. The company offers articulated dump trucks (ADT), water tankers, motor graders, tracked carriers, and articulated haulers; backhoe, skid steer, and wheel loaders; compaction; excavators, telehandlers, and rough terrain forklifts; and crushers, screeners, and conveyors for the mining and construction industries.
